objective: Check authorization and exact outputs for signed computations.
context: Public query and trust context, untrusted signed envelopes, accept/reject/abstain, exact output vector and indexed Merkle root. Referee material is separate.

steps.name: Bind request
steps.description: Identify the independent query and trusted context.

steps.name: Authorize
steps.description: Verify signature, expiry, scope and session binding.

steps.name: Commit result
steps.description: Specify canonical coefficients and indexed Merkle root.

steps.name: Independent grading
steps.description: Compare against original interpreter and distinguish invalid actions from abstention.

specific_questions.prompt: Explain the difference between a valid authorized program and the authority's external semantic honesty.
Derive conditions under which support compression and invocation-local reuse preserve all output coefficients and the original root.

native_verifier: research.authorized_exact_gym.gym score with independently retained referee manifest.
